messages.subject: Executive Value Proposition | DIB | ESG, Government Relations & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Moosa,

I am sharing an executive value proposition prepared for Dubai Islamic Bank, together with my three-page executive CV. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships and executive advisory.

My experience is relevant to DIB where sustainable finance, institutional stakeholders, ESG execution, reputation and regulated-sector delivery intersect. The attached brief sets out practical areas where I could support DIB and includes a 90-180 day action framework.

I would value a confidential discussion regarding senior opportunities within DIB. If another executive owns the closest mandate across Sustainability, ESG, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships or International Business, I would appreciate your guidance or referral.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc., Zijin Mining Group
+592 608 4735

strategic_brief.title: Executive Value Proposition for Dubai Islamic Bank
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Senior Vice President, Head of Investor Relations & Strategic Communications
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Dubai Islamic Bank is scaling sustainable finance, institutional positioning and international growth. My value proposition is to strengthen the interface between ESG commitments, government and regulatory stakeholders, strategic partnerships, reputation and operating execution. As Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I lead country-facing government relations, ESG coordination, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory in a capital-intensive multinational environment.
strategic_brief.company_context: DIB entered 2026 with continued growth and a stronger sustainable-finance platform. Its strategy requires disciplined ESG evidence, stakeholder alignment and executive communication as the bank supports clients across sectors central to the UAE economy.
